| `teammate-hears-windup` | DONE, v28.99 |

- **`p2-hit-stop-rule`:** the rebuilt draft `cw-hitstoprule` was already in the drafts folder from an earlier run and its anchors still matched, so it shipped as it was.
- **`p2-mimic-seen`, `ricochet-seen`:** these only needed the apostrophe stripped from the `now` line.
- **`p2-near-miss-pins`:** the same fix, plus one anchor retargeted, because the hit-stop ship had changed that line.
- **`teammate-hears-windup`:** I rebuilt it against HEAD. The Support MG spin-up whirr now plays through `spkPlay` (since v27.95), so it plays the whirr that way. The old check counted active-reload pings through `rlfxPing`, which the active reload no longer calls, so I removed that count.

Every ship passed the gate and the 4242 fingerprint stayed at 85/374 and 165/593. One ship (`cw-windup`) first hit a LOCK TIMEOUT and went through on the retry.

The scripts are `mk-cw-mimicseen`, `mk-cw-nearmiss`, `mk-cw-ricoseen` and `mk-cw-windup`. The shared table is updated at `tools\handoff\console\notes\2p-drafts.md`.
